meta.primaryText: You keep opening the fridge like something new is going to appear. With iEatz, something does: scan your grocery receipt once and it builds a week of healthy dinners from what's already in there — macros included, gaps filled by Instacart in one tap.
meta.headline: Dinner from what you already bought

meta.primaryText: Never wonder what's for dinner again. iEatz reads your grocery receipt and picks tonight's recipe from what you already bought — healthy, fast, and already in your kitchen.
meta.headline: Dinner, decided.
meta.description: Free on iOS. Scan a receipt, get a week of dinners.

meta.primaryText: Your fridge is hiding a week of dinners. iEatz finds them: scan your grocery receipt and it turns what you already bought into healthy 20-minute meals — before anything goes to waste.
